data: CREMA-D fixed source 1658cd342dff90010aa843eaeebd53610a08b1dc. Use all 15 actors remaining after the earlier three cohort exclusions and the 8 used in #7067, subject to available official media. No claim of novelty against uninspected branches. SHA256(salt + actor) ordering, first 6 train, next 3 dev, remaining 6 test. Salt in acquire.py. Two sentences times six emotions per actor. No actor identity, duration, clip identifier or label enters the model features.
endpoint: six-class held-out actor macro accuracy and multiclass Brier; individual-actor metrics and per-seed metrics. Three fixed seeds 6101, 6102, 6103. New experiment, small-budget offline audio-video encoder.
design: time-aligned fused 256-dimensional physical low-level feature, eight consecutive bins from 32 shared positions, train-only normalization, shared trainable projection to eight features. Compare N32 original centered/raw/joint/signed/ordinary learned and fixed boundary with identical accumulate control; causal transformer, GRU and binary-forward LIF, diagonal state-space control and direct mean linear probe. Compare both same-update and a separately labeled same-development-quality timing with failures retained.
fitting: 32 Adam updates per arm per seed, common batch size 8, lr 0.003, cross-entropy, clip grad norm 2, common batch schedule. Validate at 0/8/16/24/32, choose lowest dev cross-entropy with earliest ties. Common development-quality target accuracy >= 0.35 and multiclass Brier <= 0.82; time censored if never reached. Test every selected arm only after all fits sealed. Full fit accounting includes cold imports, initialization, train, dev and checkpoint; feature preparation and final evaluation separately timed.
confirmation: predeclared centered vs raw primary on new actors, paired per seed; report per-actor primary effects. Require positive accuracy difference in all seed pairs and at least 4/6 actors, Brier no worse in mean. Architecture advantage requires centered vs strongest dev-selected conventional candidate on independent test with corresponding same-quality time, not merely satisfying an absolute accuracy screen. Ties and empirical negatives retained. Do not tune on the test cohort.
media_attribution: Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset (CREMA-D), Cao et al.; database ODbL, individual contents DbCL. Raw media are retrieved from the source and not committed.
